other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of India
A parent or guardian may invest on behalf of a minor or a person of unsound mind
The minor investor must be at least 10 years old
Minimum deposit is ₹1000 and subsequent deposits must be in multiples of ₹100
There is no maximum limit on the amount that can be deposited
An individual may open any number of accounts
Joint accounts can be opened by up to three adults
benefits_summary: The investment amount doubles on maturity, offering a 7.5% annual compounded interest.
